# Time in therapeutic range

ENGAGE AF-TIMI 48 reported a median time in the therapeutic range of 68.4% for warfarin
([Edoxaban versus warfarin in patients with atrial fibrillation](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_1bcbd58b429315ec591b7e167517461a.md "The annualized rate of the primary end point during treatment was 1.50% with warfarin (median time in the therapeutic range, 68.4%)")).
